full_track.tags: K-Indie folk pop. Acoustic guitar plays a steady fingerstyle pattern with alternating bass notes. A clean electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with light chorus and reverb. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the acoustic guitar in a simple rhythmic pattern. Male vocals are delivered in a soft, conversational tenor range with a dry, intimate production style. The tempo is 84 BPM in 4/4 time. A subtle shaker and light percussion accents appear in the background. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the acoustic guitar and the vocal melody.
